<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ballpos(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    p=[(i,j) for i in range(10,63) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]=='p']
    if not p: return None
    r=[x[0] for x in p]; c=[x[1] for x in p]
    return (min(r)+max(r))//2,(min(c)+max(c))//2
def timer(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); return sum(1 for ch in a[63] if ch=='W')
seq=[(49,14),(47,16),(45,18),(43,20),(41,22),(39,24),(37,26),(35,28),(33,30),(31,32),(29,34),(27,36),(25,38),(23,40),(21,42),(19,44),(17,46),(15,48)]
prev=ballpos(current_frame)
for (r,c) in seq:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    bp=ballpos(current_frame)
    done=last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('run_complete')
    print(f"click({r},{c}) ball={bp} moved={bp!=prev} timer={timer(current_frame)} done={done}")
    prev=bp
    if done: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
